headline: Central Fronts Fracture as Marban Hollow and Mooring County Erupt
war_summary: Since the early evening edition, combat has intensified sharply across the central and northern sectors. Marban Hollow has seen another stronghold fall into ruined no-man's-land, leaving the sector divided between three Colonial garrisons, two Warden redoubts, and three gutted positions following five fresh clashes centered around Checkpoint Bua and Oster Wall. Simultaneously, Mooring County broke hours of quietude with four swift base turnovers at The Wind Hills, though Warden forces retain complete territorial possession across all twelve installations. The bloodletting in Weathered Expanse shows no respite, logging seven further base transitions in the last two hours and reducing four strategic hubs to desolate neutrality amidst punishing losses on both sides. In Linn of Mercy, the bloody standoff finally cracked open with four rapid base captures and demolitions across Outwich Ranch and Lathair, stranding one position in neutral ruins. Further west, Nevish Line recorded two additional base engagements while Warden defenders consolidated the district, and Callahan's Passage maintains its furious, accelerating attrition without shifting a single parapet.
